core_meaning.primary_meaning: Hajiyah is an Arabic-origin name meaning “A woman who has performed the Hajj”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hajiyah corresponds to the Arabic form حاجية (Arabic root ح ج ج (ḥ-j-j); حاجية (ḥājiya)). Its core sense is pilgrim (one who performs the hajj). Hajiyah is the feminine of حاجّ — حاجية (ḥājiya) 'a woman who has performed the Hajj'. The source gloss 'pilgrim, traveler' is a fair rendering.
